newsitem.title: USA: Michael Kennedy and wife separate.
newsitem.headline: Michael Kennedy and wife separate.

text.p: Michael Kennedy and his wife, Victoria Gifford Kennedy, the daughter of sportscaster Frank Gifford, issued a statement Thursday saying they had separated.

"It is with regret that we announce our decision to separate. We have reached this decision amicably," the statement said. "Out of respect for our families, we hope the press and public will understand our wish to decline further comment on ths personal matter."
Michael Kennedy, the 39-year-old son of the late Sen. Robert Kennedy, has been running the nonprofit Citizens Energy Corp., founded by his older brother, Representative Joe Kennedy, who is 44.
The congressman has had his own marital troubles of late. His first wife, Sheila, recently wrote a book detailing their years together and is seeking to contest the annulment of their marriage.
